dimensions.assessment: Targets foreign countries meeting specific criteria regarding relations with Taiwan and pressure from the People's Republic of China.
dimensions.evidence: Amounts available pursuant to the authorization of appropriations under subsection (a) may be used in countries that maintain official relations with Taiwan

dimensions.assessment: Provides targeted foreign assistance funding capped at $5,000,000 per country per fiscal year.
dimensions.evidence: A country described in subsection (b) may not receive more than $5,000,000 of funds made available... during any fiscal year.

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes $10,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026, 2027, and 2028 out of existing Countering People's Republic of China Influence Fund amounts.
dimensions.evidence: there is authorized to be appropriated $10,000,000 for each such fiscal year to support Taiwan's international space.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes specific funding authorities, project uses, reporting requirements, and implementation guidelines for the Department of State.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of State, in consultation with the heads of other relevant Federal agencies, shall coordinate and carry out activities described

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations and reporting requirements across a three-year window (fiscal years 2026 through 2028).
dimensions.evidence: for each of fiscal years 2026, 2027, and 2028

missing_information: Exact recipient countries are not named in the text.
Total overall impact on broader foreign aid budgets beyond the specified authorization is not detailed.
importance_detail.rationale: Authorizes $10,000,000 annually for fiscal years 2026, 2027, and 2028 from the Countering People's Republic of China Influence Fund to support Taiwan's international space and partner countries.
